name: crossfile
description: Two coordinated one-line edits in two files plus two independent bugs. fmt.money reads its symbol under the wrong option key, options.get(CURRENCY_KEY) for options.get(SYMBOL_KEY) (both module constants of fmt.py; the tests pin `symbol=`), and invoice.render's local `cash` helper builds its options dict under CURRENCY_KEY as well. Either identifier swap alone regresses: fixing the definition makes the fmt tests pass but every invoice line falls back to '$' (two invoice tests break); fixing only the call site changes nothing for fmt and breaks the same two. Only the pair (one patch of two files) is green: test_money_ignores_currency_option pins that the `currency` option is never read as a symbol, so a definition that reads both keys is not a fix either. Independently, tax.tax_for exempts the threshold amount itself (<= for <) and discount.apply_discount negates the percentage-code test (`not in`). Eight tests fail, seventeen pass.
